coverage: Exact final driver and 85 driver tests read in full; pure helper and 105 tests were independently reviewed previously and rerun together at final hashes.

Fixed two-panel, eight-game, base/alternate-noise selectors with both home/away contrasts produce exactly 64 ordered comparisons from 32 fine rows. Fine-to-main input, seed, source, protocol, native binary and mask/checkpoint identity checks were inspected without reading actual waveform payloads.

Inspected actual typed 2000-step arrays, 4064 KC count ceiling, 2/22 DAN population decoding, binary sampled events, role/global/body mappings, full count and coarse-bin reductions, unused zeros, gains and excluded-edge identity. Header declared shape/payload checks precede NPZ allocation.

Inspected streaming pre/post source hashes, bounded strict JSON, unique nonsymlink bound paths, exclusive output, immutable plan, full row counts and preservation of previously completed arrays on failure.

Independent synthetic suite includes complete tiny 32-file/64-contrast bound archive and metadata IO success plus malformed identities, arrays, count domains, missing/extra rows, source mutation, timing and persistence failures.

Launcher uses an argv vector and unresolved repository venv path, exclusive execution outputs and subprocess.run(timeout=120), which kills and reaps the direct child on TimeoutExpired. Parent time starts before child interpreter startup. No launcher or actual data job was run in this review.
completion_acceptance: Parent execution must have exit_code 0, timed_out false and wall_seconds below 120.
terminal-error.json must be absent; status.json must report completed and 64 contrasts.
completion.json must report complete with the same run_id and 64 contrasts, and its status_sha256 and summary_sha256 must match the final current bytes.
All final frozen input bindings must remain unchanged; the draft plan is not itself an execution approval.

A completion-write cap crossing leaves a stale marker, a terminal error and failed status with a different hash. Marker presence alone is explicitly insufficient. The final test delta verifies this invalidation and earlier-cap marker absence.
interpretation_limits: Common KC spike selection is conditional on this exact pooled bridge, source and input identity, and extends through the first difference in either pooled DAN channel inclusive. Rule/filter prefix uses the preceding exclusive interval. No extra nine-step grace or post-divergence taught KC reconstruction is permitted.

per_cell_dan_different_whole_prefix_bins is descriptive over the inclusive KC prefix. If the first pooled divergence j is the last step in a bin, that included bin contains the divergence; its cell-count difference is not evidence of an earlier hidden difference under equal pooling. Strictly pre-j complete bins are required for that narrower inference.
Pooled equality does not establish all individual taught DAN timings, local dopamine exposure, a new nonlinear candidate trajectory or a biological impossibility.
Generic secondary numeric fields such as stored rates are schema/domain checked; this is not an independent reconstruction of every recorded simulator output or every neuronal state.
No new gain/interface/mask/parameter, qualification threshold or conditioning claim is introduced. Actual archive results remain a separate post-dispatch review.

verification.ruff: All checks passed on final driver and test files.
